{{recipe}}

This classic '''tuna salad''' recipe is from the 1940's U.S.

==Ingredients==
*1 can (6–9½­ oz / ~170–270 g) [[Cookbook:Tuna|tuna]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*½ stalk [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]], finely chopped
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]] (low fat can work)
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. chopped [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onion]] or ½ tsp dried chopped white or yellow [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Hard Boiled Eggs|hard boiled egg]], chopped (or two hard boiled egg whites and a bit of oil olive oil to make up the difference)
*Ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Paprika|Paprika]] (optional)
*[[Cookbook:Lettuce|Lettuce]] (optional)

==Procedure==
#Drain and squeeze tuna dry, discarding liquid or reserving for some other use.
#Combine tuna, apple, celery, mayonnaise, lemon juice, green onion, egg, and pepper.
#Refrigerate 1 hour or more.  
#Sprinkle with paprika and trim with lettuce, if desired.
